description:
For the final outcome, call status with waitSeconds above 0 (one server-side wait). A snapshot (waitSeconds 0) is only progress: wait at least nextPollInSeconds; each task can be polled at most once a minute. On timeout, call again with unfinished taskIds. list_generations / get_generation: history.
Actions and their required fields: status (taskIds); list_generations (no required fields); get_generation (generationId).

action.description: What to do: status | list_generations | get_generation. The description lists the fields each action needs.

generationId.description: The generation ID (the generationId field from video_tasks (action: list_generations)).

limit.description: Max generations to return (1-200). Defaults to 50, newest first.

taskIds.description: Engine task IDs from generate_video, one per video (up to 12). A whole batch is one call.

waitSeconds.description: Above 0 is the final outcome: block until tasks finish (max 600). 0 is a snapshot: wait at least nextPollInSeconds (a task is polled at most once a minute). On timeout, retry unfinished taskIds.

name: video_tasks
